## Ground rules

- [ ] No kernel driver, Test Mode or Secure Boot change
- [ ] Nothing resets the AirPods or touches their firmware
- [ ] Any pairing step says to double-tap once and stop when the light flashes white
- [ ] Any registry or driver change is documented with its exact undo
- [ ] Untested behaviour is labelled as untested
